runtime_requirement: Leave all bot, training, AutoResearch, API and UI runtime processes OFF; no operational startup, provider API calls, wallet orders or active model/policy promotion in this stage.
execution_scope: PAPER configuration remains unchanged; synthetic native source/transport/feature/model-contract tests only.

data_quality_contract.owning_workflow: Native architecture implementation with a scoped Data Analytics data-quality companion; not a standalone financial report or new dataset assessment.
data_quality_contract.authoritative_sources: Current original publishing Python modules, reviewed implementation sources and reproducible native tests. Official provider documentation supports protocol/grain definitions, not actual access acceptance.
data_quality_contract.grain: A token mint birth, a selected Pair/pool event, a provider HTTP receipt and an original queue observation are different records and clocks.
data_quality_contract.missingness: Unknown original mint birth remains null; a genuine measured zero is distinct. No Pair/listing/pool metadata is promoted to mint birth by the changed adapters or common sanitizer.
data_quality_contract.historical_scope: Read-only historical feature projection uses original event clocks. Existing datasets, operator models and policy artifacts are not rewritten.
data_quality_contract.notebook_omission: The scoped companion reuses the owning implementation's inspectable pytest cases and source diffs; a separate notebook would duplicate native regression and transport evidence.

findings.finding: Original Pair/listing clocks supplied canonical mint birth through both normalization and shared age/sanitizer consumers; fresh Pair snapshots could rejuvenate queued known birth.
findings.evidence: Native fixed-time synthetic 100-day birth versus 3-minute venue/listing cases, common age, historical feature projection and actual entry merge.
findings.impact: Invalid admission age and learned temporal features. This proves a software semantic defect, not measured market opportunity loss.
findings.remediation: Separate canonical birth aliases from venue metadata and retain queued known birth and original queue time.

findings.finding: Original Dex lookup used an obsolete token route, assumed dictionary responses, tolerated unknown chain identity and could match an unrelated base through tokenAddress aliases.
findings.evidence: Native get_pair and _fetch_json with isolated fake HTTP responses, no monkeypatch of production normalization or routing.
findings.impact: Response-shape errors, wrong identity selection and lost valid market inputs.
findings.remediation: Current documented token-pairs route, list and retained wrapper parsing, explicit canonical Solana base identity, preserved pair-to-base fallback, invalid input rejection before HTTP.

findings.finding: Original age-using model metadata and advisory no-change fingerprints did not declare the changed clock generation.
findings.evidence: Raw/encoded age and queue-age contract cases plus native model reader rejection before deserialization in isolated temporary files.
findings.impact: An obsolete model could consume a meaningfully different feature generation.
findings.remediation: Require original_mint_birth_not_venue_v2 for age-using schemas and advisory pipeline 12; unrelated numeric models are unchanged. No active artifact promotion.

implemented: analytics/token_time.py: canonical birth aliases, typed nullable UTC venue diagnostic, detached atomic venue identity/clock record and explicit age generation.
utils/data_utils.py: common sanitizer no longer resurrects Pair/listing clocks as mint birth.
fetcher/dexscreener.py: current token-pairs route, native list/wrapper handling, explicit chain/base identity, malformed optional-node isolation, existing retry/cache/cancellation ownership retained.
fetcher/geckoterminal.py: pool event diagnostics separated from untyped token/listing metadata; existing provider transport remains unaudited here.
fetcher/birdeye.py: legacy pool-normalizer event clock separated from mint birth; token endpoint and provider/auth protocol not certified here.
utils/price_service.py and runtime/entry_observation.py: venue identity and clock move together only for the selected pair; queued known birth and original residence stay independent.
features/numeric_encoding.py and ml/runner_advisory_learning.py: changed temporal input generation checked without rewriting legacy artifacts or activating policies.
tests/test_venue_birth_semantics.py: 91 synthetic native cases. Existing epoch replay test now uses explicit token birth rather than a Pair clock; advisory context expectation follows pipeline 12.

official_references.scope: Current token-pairs route and separate nullable pairCreatedAt schema; documentation read, not operational provider acceptance.
Token and included-pool resource distinction; no authoritative original mint birth supplied by the reviewed metadata.
Pool-created clock belongs to the pool resource, not original base-mint birth.

independent_learning_gap.inspection: Read-only native-loader Parquet precedence, age declarations and schema census; no row identities, fitting or data rewrites.
independent_learning_gap.qualification: Absence of explicit generation columns does not prove every historical age is wrong. No T0 proof content was validated. Model schema generation alone is not original input provenance.
independent_learning_gap.next_action: Audit original temporal input proof through capture/export/training, and automatic replacement of obsolete incumbent age generation. Source inspection finds runner training raises ValueError for unsupported incumbent input encoding; this is not yet a native successor regression or measured operational failure.

isolated_native_preparation_probe.input: One synthetic historical row without temporal generation proof
isolated_native_preparation_probe.scope: Actual preparation and metadata helpers only; not a trained, selected or operational model. This identifies the next original temporal-input provenance regression.

post_qa_formatting.change: Removed one excess blank line at EOF from tests/test_venue_birth_semantics.py in both roots. No production-source or test logic change.
post_qa_formatting.scope: Complete suites and preflights are the recorded pre-format runs; they were not restarted or misrepresented as post-format runs. Exact nonfunctional delta is independently checked.

preflights.scope: Compilation, config, profile and seven isolated report builders. External pytest attestation follows the actual completed same-source full suites; no operational startup.

current_root_probe.scope: Cold source/config and synthetic normalization only; not operational startup or provider access.

shutdown.qualification: Read-only mtime census, not a cryptographic historical preservation proof. Intended stop SQL/log and preflight metrics are excluded.

verification.publication: Exact implementation commit, remote equality and final clean synchronization are recorded in work/venue-birth-semantics-delivery-receipt.json after publication; no self-referential commit hash is claimed by this file.

remaining_required_work: Obtain authoritative original mint birth with independently checked identity/source semantics when unknown; generic legacy birth aliases alone do not authenticate birth.

Check historical temporal input provenance before declaring new-generation training metadata, and independently reproduce successor replacement of obsolete age-encoding incumbents. Existing numeric ages are not relabelled by this stage.

Measure actual provider freshness, rate/access behavior, latency, production-size artifact throughput and independently observed opportunity/decision coverage.
Complete broader original source/executed-process ownership, creator/longer-regime learning validation, full-strategy capital/exit/financial constraints and first-launch failure acceptance.

completion_rule: This bounded stage may be software-verified and published while the complete architecture/profitability goal remains active and unproven. Do not start the operational bot or declare it profitable.
